## 1. Initial Data Points & Weights {background-color="#f8fafc"}

All 5 points start with **uniform sample weights**: $w_i^{(1)} = \frac{1}{5} = 0.200$.

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 5 toy points in 2D
X = np.array([
    [1.0, 4.0],  # x0: +1
    [2.0, 1.0],  # x1: -1
    [3.0, 3.0],  # x2: -1
    [4.0, 5.0],  # x3: +1
    [5.0, 2.0]   # x4: +1
])
y = np.array([1, -1, -1, 1, 1])
N = len(X)
w1 = np.full(N, 1.0 / N)

# Helper function: draw crisp decision tree diagrams on ax2
def draw_tree(ax, condition_str, left_text, right_text, err, alpha, round_num):
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10); ax.set_ylim(0, 10); ax.axis('off')
    # Root Decision Node
    ax.text(5, 8.5, condition_str, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", fc="#f8fafc", ec="#0f172a", lw=2))
    # Branches
    ax.annotate("", xy=(2.5, 5.2), xytext=(4.2, 7.8), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2, color="#334155"))
    ax.text(2.8, 6.7, "Yes", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color="#16a34a")
    ax.annotate("", xy=(7.5, 5.2), xytext=(5.8, 7.8), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2, color="#334155"))
    ax.text(7.0, 6.7, "No", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color="#dc2626")
    # Leaf Nodes
    fc_l = "#e0f2fe" if "+1" in left_text else "#fee2e2"
    ec_l = "#0284c7" if "+1" in left_text else "#ef4444"
    ax.text(2.5, 4.2, left_text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", fc=fc_l, ec=ec_l, lw=2))
    fc_r = "#e0f2fe" if "+1" in right_text else "#fee2e2"
    ec_r = "#0284c7" if "+1" in right_text else "#ef4444"
    ax.text(7.5, 4.2, right_text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", fc=fc_r, ec=ec_r, lw=2))
    # Analytics Box
    metrics = (
        f"Stump {round_num} Analytics\n"
        f"---------------------------\n"
        f"Weighted Error (e_{round_num}): {err:.3f}\n"
        f"Voting Weight  (a_{round_num}): {alpha:.3f}"
    )
    ax.text(5, 1.3, metrics, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, family='monospace',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.5", fc="#f1f5f9", ec="#94a3b8", lw=1.5))

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# Standardized 2D Feature Space Plot
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=w1[y==-1]*2000, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=2, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=w1[y==1]*2000, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=2, label='Class +1')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Initial Feature Space ($w_i = 0.200$)", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=2, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Weights Bar Chart
ax2.bar([f"$x_{i}$" for i in range(N)], w1, color='#64748b', edgecolor='#334155', width=0.45, label='Sample Weight')
ax2.axhline(0.2, color='#0284c7', linestyle='--', lw=1.5, label='Uniform Baseline (0.200)')
ax2.set_title("Initial Weights Distribution $w^{(1)}$", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel("Weight Value", fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 0.6)
ax2.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax2.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=2, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

plt.show()
```

---

## 2. Stump 1: Decision Boundary & Tree Diagram

Vertical cut at $x_1 = 3.50$. Only point $x_0$ is misclassified ($\epsilon_1 = 0.200, \alpha_1 = 0.693$).

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
err1 = 0.200
alpha1 = 0.5 * np.log((1.0 - err1) / err1)  # 0.6931

xx, yy = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0, 6, 250), np.linspace(0, 6, 250))
Z1 = np.where(xx >= 3.5, 1, -1)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# 2D Plot with Boundary
ax1.contourf(xx, yy, Z1, levels=[-1.5, 0, 1.5], colors=['#fee2e2', '#e0f2fe'], alpha=0.55)
ax1.contour(xx, yy, Z1, levels=[0], colors='#0f172a', linewidths=2.5)
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=w1[y==-1]*2000, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=1.5, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=w1[y==1]*2000, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=1.5, label='Class +1')
ax1.scatter([X[0, 0]], [X[0, 1]], s=360, facecolors='none', edgecolors='#f59e0b', lw=3, label='Mistake ($x_0$)')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Stump 1 Cut: $x_1 \geq 3.50$", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=3, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Tree Diagram
draw_tree(ax2, "Is $x_1 \geq 3.50$?", "Predict +1", "Predict -1", err1, alpha1, 1)

plt.show()
```

---

## 3. Weight Updates After Stump 1

Point $x_0$ was misclassified $\Rightarrow$ its weight swells from $0.200 \to 0.500$. Correct points shrink to $0.125$.

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
w2 = np.array([0.500, 0.125, 0.125, 0.125, 0.125])

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# 2D Plot with Updated Weights
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=w2[y==-1]*2000, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=2, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=w2[y==1]*2000, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=2, label='Class +1')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$\n({w2[i]:.3f})", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Weights $w^{(2)}$: $x_0$ Swells to 0.500", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=2, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Bar Comparison
idx = np.arange(N)
width = 0.35
ax2.bar(idx - width/2, w1, width, label='Round 1 ($w^{(1)}$)', color='#94a3b8')
bars2 = ax2.bar(idx + width/2, w2, width, label='Round 2 ($w^{(2)}$)', color='#3b82f6')
bars2[0].set_color('#ef4444')
ax2.set_xticks(idx)
ax2.set_xticklabels([f"$x_{i}$" for i in range(N)])
ax2.set_title("Shift: $w^{(1)} \Rightarrow w^{(2)}$", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel("Weight Value", fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 0.6)
ax2.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax2.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=2, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

plt.show()
```

## 4. Stump 2: Decision Boundary & Tree Diagram

Targeting large sample $x_0$, Stump 2 cuts horizontally at $x_2 = 3.50$. Only $x_4$ is misclassified ($\epsilon_2 = 0.125, \alpha_2 = 0.973$).

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
err2 = 0.125
alpha2 = 0.5 * np.log((1.0 - err2) / err2)  # 0.9730

Z2 = np.where(yy >= 3.5, 1, -1)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# 2D Plot with Boundary
ax1.contourf(xx, yy, Z2, levels=[-1.5, 0, 1.5], colors=['#fee2e2', '#e0f2fe'], alpha=0.55)
ax1.contour(xx, yy, Z2, levels=[0], colors='#0f172a', linewidths=2.5)
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=w2[y==-1]*2000, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=1.5, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=w2[y==1]*2000, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=1.5, label='Class +1')
ax1.scatter([X[4, 0]], [X[4, 1]], s=360, facecolors='none', edgecolors='#f59e0b', lw=3, label='Mistake ($x_4$)')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Stump 2 Cut: $x_2 \geq 3.50$", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=3, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Tree Diagram
draw_tree(ax2, "Is $x_2 \geq 3.50$?", "Predict +1", "Predict -1", err2, alpha2, 2)

plt.show()
```

---

## 5. Combined Decision Boundary ($H_2 = \text{sign}(\alpha_1 h_1 + \alpha_2 h_2)$)

$$H_2(x) = \text{sign}(0.693 \cdot h_1(x) + 0.973 \cdot h_2(x)) \quad \Rightarrow \quad \textbf{4/5 Correct (80.0\%)}$$

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
vote2 = alpha1 * Z1 + alpha2 * Z2
Z_comb2 = np.where(vote2 >= 0, 1, -1)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# Standardized 2D Combined Boundary Plot
ax1.contourf(xx, yy, Z_comb2, levels=[-1.5, 0, 1.5], colors=['#fee2e2', '#e0f2fe'], alpha=0.6)
ax1.contour(xx, yy, Z_comb2, levels=[0], colors='#0f172a', linewidths=2.5)
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=w2[y==-1]*2000, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=2, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=w2[y==1]*2000, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=2, label='Class +1')
ax1.scatter([X[4, 0]], [X[4, 1]], s=360, facecolors='none', edgecolors='#f59e0b', lw=3, label='H2 Mistake ($x_4$)')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Ensemble H2(x) Boundary (Acc: 80.0%)", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=3, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Vote Ledger Infographic on ax2
ax2.set_xlim(0, 10); ax2.set_ylim(0, 10); ax2.axis('off')
ax2.text(5, 9.2, "Committee Voting Breakdown (H2)", ha="center", va="center",
         fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

ledger_text = (
    "Point | True | h1   | h2   | Vote Score | Result\n"
    "--------------------------------------------------\n"
    "x0    |  +1  | -1   | +1   |   +0.280   |  +1  OK\n"
    "x1    |  -1  | -1   | -1   |   -1.666   |  -1  OK\n"
    "x2    |  -1  | -1   | -1   |   -1.666   |  -1  OK\n"
    "x3    |  +1  | +1   | +1   |   +1.666   |  +1  OK\n"
    "x4    |  +1  | +1   | -1   |   -0.280   |  -1  ERR\n"
)
ax2.text(5, 5.0, ledger_text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, family='monospace',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.7", fc="#f8fafc", ec="#94a3b8", lw=1.5))
ax2.text(5, 1.2, "* Notice: a2 > a1, so Stump 2 saved x0,\n  but Stump 2 overruled Stump 1 on x4.",
         ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9.5, color="#475569")

plt.show()
```

## 6. Weight Updates After Stump 2

Point $x_4$ was misclassified by Stump 2 $\Rightarrow$ its weight swells to $w_4^{(3)} = 0.500$.

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
w3 = np.array([2/7, 1/14, 1/14, 1/14, 0.500])

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# 2D Plot with Weights
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=w3[y==-1]*2000, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=2, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=w3[y==1]*2000, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=2, label='Class +1')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$\n({w3[i]:.3f})", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Weights $w^{(3)}$: $x_4$ Swells to 0.500", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=2, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# 3-Round Progression Bar Chart
width = 0.25
ax2.bar(idx - width, w1, width, label='Round 1', color='#94a3b8')
ax2.bar(idx, w2, width, label='Round 2', color='#60a5fa')
bars3 = ax2.bar(idx + width, w3, width, label='Round 3', color='#2563eb')
bars3[4].set_color('#ef4444')
ax2.set_xticks(idx)
ax2.set_xticklabels([f"$x_{i}$" for i in range(N)])
ax2.set_title("Progression: $w^{(1)} \Rightarrow w^{(2)} \Rightarrow w^{(3)}$", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel("Weight Value", fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 0.6)
ax2.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax2.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=3, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

plt.show()
```

## 8. Final Combined Decision Boundary ($H_3$) {transition="zoom"}

$$H_3(x) = \text{sign}(0.693 \cdot h_1(x) + 0.973 \cdot h_2(x) + 1.283 \cdot h_3(x)) \quad \Rightarrow \quad \textbf{5/5 Correct (100.0\%)}$$

```{python}
#| fig-width: 10.5
#| fig-height: 4.4
vote3 = alpha1 * Z1 + alpha2 * Z2 + alpha3 * Z3
Z_comb3 = np.where(vote3 >= 0, 1, -1)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.22, wspace=0.35)

# Standardized 2D Final Boundary Plot
ax1.contourf(xx, yy, Z_comb3, levels=[-1.5, 0, 1.5], colors=['#fee2e2', '#e0f2fe'], alpha=0.6)
ax1.contour(xx, yy, Z_comb3, levels=[0], colors='#0f172a', linewidths=2.5)
ax1.scatter(X[y==-1, 0], X[y==-1, 1], s=180, color='#ef4444', edgecolors='#991b1b', lw=2, label='Class -1')
ax1.scatter(X[y==1, 0], X[y==1, 1], s=180, color='#0284c7', edgecolors='#0369a1', lw=2, label='Class +1')
for i in range(N):
    ax1.annotate(f"$x_{i}$", (X[i, 0] + 0.15, X[i, 1] + 0.15), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 6); ax1.set_ylim(0, 6)
ax1.set_box_aspect(1)
ax1.set_xlabel("Feature $x_1$", fontsize=10); ax1.set_ylabel("Feature $x_2$", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("Final Ensemble H3 (Acc: 100.0%)", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#15803d')
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=2, frameon=True, fontsize=8.5)

# Consensus Scorecard on ax2
ax2.set_xlim(0, 10); ax2.set_ylim(0, 10); ax2.axis('off')
ax2.text(5, 9.2, "Final Committee Consensus (H3)", ha="center", va="center",
         fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color="#15803d")

final_ledger = (
    "Point | True | h1   | h2   | h3   | Total Vote | Result\n"
    "--------------------------------------------------------\n"
    "x0    |  +1  | -1   | +1   | +1   |   +1.562   |  +1  OK\n"
    "x1    |  -1  | -1   | -1   | -1   |   -2.949   |  -1  OK\n"
    "x2    |  -1  | -1   | -1   | +1   |   -0.384   |  -1  OK\n"
    "x3    |  +1  | +1   | +1   | +1   |   +2.949   |  +1  OK\n"
    "x4    |  +1  | +1   | -1   | +1   |   +1.003   |  +1  OK\n"
)
ax2.text(5, 5.0, final_ledger, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9.5, family='monospace',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.7", fc="#f0fdf4", ec="#16a34a", lw=2))
ax2.text(5, 1.2, "* Perfect 100% classification reached\n  via consensus of 3 simple orthogonal cuts!",
         ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9.5, color="#15803d", fontweight='bold')

plt.show()
```

## 9. Evolution Summary: $H_1 \Rightarrow H_2 \Rightarrow H_3$

From single 1D orthogonal thresholds to an enclosed non-linear committee classifier:

